Industrial / Flex Space for Lease – Prime Concord Location

2035 Wilshire Court SW | Concord, NC 28025

Excellent opportunity to lease a versatile 2,682 SF industrial/flex property situated on approximately 0.77 acres in an established Concord industrial area.

Previously occupied by a hydraulic and machinery repair business, this property offers a functional layout ideal for automotive-related services, equipment repair, contractors, light manufacturing, warehousing, and other permitted industrial uses.

The building features a spacious open workshop with three overhead garage doors, a customer reception/waiting area, two office spaces, and a bathroom. The property also offers a generous paved area for parking, vehicle access, and maneuverability.

Conveniently located near Highway 601, US-29, and the I-85 corridor, providing accessibility throughout Concord, Cabarrus County, and the greater Charlotte region.

Property Highlights:

-2,682 SF industrial/flex building
-Approximately 0.77-acre parcel
-I-1 industrial zoning
-Three overhead garage doors
-Large open workshop/warehouse area
-Reception/waiting area and two offices
-One bathroom
-Paved parking and vehicle maneuvering area
-Steel-frame construction
-Convenient access to major transportation corridors

Rental Terms

-Monthly Rent: $2,995
-Lease Type: Modified Gross
-Application Fee: $120

Available: December 1, 2026

For additional information or to schedule a private tour, contact GreyRock Commercial Real Estate at (704) 707-4656.

All proposed uses are subject to applicable zoning requirements and landlord approval.
